title: Rabbi Yose ben Yehoshua
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chullin 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.56b.3), [Niddah 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Niddah.24a.1) and [Jerusalem Talmud Niddah, chapter 3, at the end of halakhah 2](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Niddah.3.2.9). In all of them Rabbi Yochanan speaks in his name. It appears that he was among the last Tannaim, who lived after Rabbi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman infers that Rabbi Yose lived after Rabbi.
The Bavli passages call him Rabbi Yose ben Yehoshua. The Yerushalmi has Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Yehoshua. All three name Rabbi Yochanan as the transmitter.
